title: Installation
subtitle: Install qortex-resource (alpha)
description: Add the core package (vanilla / non-React). For React, install only qortex-resource-react — it depends on this package.

callouts.title: Alpha
callouts.content: APIs may change before 1.0. Pin exact versions in production pilots. Feedback welcome.

content: qortex-resource is the framework-agnostic core for entity/form lifecycle: fetch → draft edit → validate → local persist → save → feedback.

sections.title: Install
sections.content: Add the core package with your package manager:

code.code:
# npm
npm install qortex-resource@0.1.0-alpha.0

# yarn
yarn add qortex-resource@0.1.0-alpha.0

# pnpm
pnpm add qortex-resource@0.1.0-alpha.0

sections.title: React apps
sections.content: Install only the React package — it depends on `qortex-resource` and installs it for you:

sections.title: Optional peers
sections.content:
• **Zod** — use `zodResolver` for schema validation
• **qortex-db** — custom persist `db` adapter
• **qortex-query / store** — bridge via `source.query` or `source.state`
